{{Quote|A world of our own. A Jedi world, safe for the children. It's a worthy goal.|[[Tionne Solusar]]|<ref name="EOVR">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>}}
'''Eclipse''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was hidden in an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field|field]]. It was discovered by [[Tionne Solusar|Tionne]] and [[Kam Solusar]] when they were looking for a safeworld for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. It was where [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] created [[Eclipse Station]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
